dedupe_keys.name: sbb open data platform data sbb ch swiss federal railways infrastructure and operations data

description: Swiss Federal Railways publishes about 60 open data sets on its Opendatasoft platform, data.sbb.ch. They describe railway infrastructure and operations: lines with operating points (1,892 records from SBB Infrastruktur, with line number, kilometre position, official name, DiDok and UIC codes and coordinates, updated 22 September 2026), line kilometrage and line polygons, bridges, tunnels, level crossings, noise protection walls, fire walls, emergency exits along the line, platforms and platform edges, stops with accessibility features, train counts per section and per month, passenger frequency and station user counts, actual running data, rolling stock, construction projects and SBB parcels. Coverage is the SBB network in Switzerland. Access: free with anonymous access through the Opendatasoft explore API; the licence is set out on the platform's licence page, which did not render as text for the cloud reader. Caveats: the sets cover SBB's own network, not all Swiss operators, and several sets are named by year (for example yearly train formations). The data support rail network models for network flow, capacity planning and hazard exposure of structures such as bridges and tunnels. They complement opentransportdata.swiss and the Swiss railway network representations catalogued here.
